    Class
    Description
    EquinixResponse
    Immutable view of a single HTTP exchange, exposing exactly what response handling needs: the status line, a read-only case-insensitive snapshot of the response headers, and the body stream with its declared length.
    Page
    A deserialized page of a list/search response: the raw JSON items plus the response's pagination metadata and the request/response pair used to fetch it (for lazy paging).

    A client that can fetch the next page of a POST-based search and map the response.

    A paginated list of resources returned by Equinix API list operations.
